name: Esar Haddon Esarhaddon
overview: Scripture identifies Esarhaddon as the son and successor of Sennacherib, who ascended the throne after his father was slain by his own sons, as recorded in Isaiah 37:38. He is also known by the name Asnapper, a title associated with his role in relocating various peoples, including those settled in Samaria, as mentioned in Ezra 4:10. Additionally, Ezra 4:2 highlights that the worship practices linked to Esarhaddon's reign influenced the people who sought to join Zerubbabel in rebuilding, demonstrating his historical significance in the post-exilic period.
